outputs.explanation: Panel A is a schematic depicting the experimental pipeline; it is not a plot of quantitative data, so the check does not apply.
Panel B contains micrograph/imaging panels (fluorescence, H&E, bright-field), not a plot showing averages.
Panel C is a bar chart with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) for each group (Normal lung, LUAD, LUSC) are overlaid on the bars.
Panel D is a bar chart with mean and 95% CI, and individual data points (dots) for High pH and Low pH groups are overlaid on the bars.
Panel E is a schematic illustrating the immunosuppressive niche model; it does not display quantitative averaged data.
